reviews.conclusion: Nether exit, overworld eye measurement and return include menu sessions at proxy 2.75-5.75, 9.5-11 and 14-15.75 s. Combined visible-menu bounds are 6.25-7.75 s, shorter than the 8.317 s deficit; the rearranged obscured capture at 11.25-13.75 s could contain additional paused time but its state is unknown. Exact closure remains unresolved.

Bastion bartering and nether traversal contain settings at proxy 3-3.25, 9.25-10.25 and 18.75-19.75 s. Combined 2.25-3.75 s sampled menu bounds contain the 3.108 s deficit. Inventory use is not counted as paused time.

Portal travel into the stronghold shows loading at proxy 4 s, then game/settings at 4.25-5.25, 8.75-9 and 9.5-10 s. Their combined 1.75-3.25 s bounds contain the 2.3 s deficit. No exact native-frame closure is asserted.
Options/skin/video settings during fortress combat last 1.75-2.25 s, compatible with -2.0333 s. Combat then continues; no cut is established from the sampled proxy.

A deliberate bed death and respawn occur in the same stronghold, followed by End entry. Pause/feedback-dialog exposure at proxy 14.5-15 s and settings at 15.5-16.5 s total approximately 1.5-2.5 s, compatible with the -1.9 s deficit. Death itself is not counted as a GUI pause.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
